workflow_runs.name: Qualify original Blender library linking and packed data
workflow_runs.display_title: Run the original 17-method Blender library cohort with verified fixtures

head_commit.message:
Run the original 17-method Blender library cohort with verified fixtures

Preserve the exact upstream main/helper, native case inventory, all three LFS fixture payloads and their sibling output layout. Require complete fixture-preservation receipts independently of passing methods. Add separate native/browser qualification and retain blocked evidence.

Record the verified four-file IO exchange and keep provenance, full-facet coverage and cross-engine library closure separate.

Validation: 119 infrastructure tests passed; integrated official native Blender executed all 17 unchanged methods with 14 complete class drivers, three unchanged fixtures and 22 verified output files.
